parse_ffmpeg_transcode_output: parse ffmpeg video transcode output to extract per-level encoding time and throughput metrics
extract_encoder_throughput_MBps: extract per-resolution-level throughput in MBps from ffmpeg encoder stdout lines
compute_harmonic_mean_throughput: compute the harmonic mean of throughput across all resolution levels for benchmark scoring
compute_geometric_mean_throughput: compute the geometric mean of throughput across all resolution levels for benchmark scoring
score_svt_encoder_baseline: score an SVT encoder by comparing its harmonic mean throughput against the baseline value
